$comment: GENUINE live behavioral attestations ONLY — never fabricated. Each record is the recorded provenance of a real `npm run test:case` run (see tools/test-runner.mjs / tools/runs/<runId>/<harness>/run.json). A `pass` behavioral attestation proves the pack, projected to a harness's canonical discovery path and driven headless, is discovered and produces the semantic outcome. Live evidence is per-HARNESS discovery, NOT per-CHANNEL placement: no run installs via the native marketplace/plugin path or places checkout symlinks — those channel mechanics are proven DETERMINISTICALLY (exact manifest/catalog paths, proven absence, exact link targets) and symlink-placement behavioral proof is #44, out of scope. So one passing attestation is the behavioral half every supported (channel × harness) cell for that harness needs; the deterministic half (packaging/paths/provenance) is proven by the tests named in tools/acceptance/matrix.mjs. A harness WITHOUT a passing attestation has its supported cells recorded as pending and WITHHELD from advertised support (registry + generated README), enforced by tools/acceptance/matrix.test.mjs. Attestations bind to their recorded `commit` but not (yet) to a content hash of the pack exercised, so a later skill-content change does not auto-invalidate a prior run — re-run and re-record on skill-content changes. Add attestations only from a genuine recorded run; do not hand-edit verdicts.
